n733f883394d.s: In the NISAR satellite, which radar system is supplied by NASA?
n733f883394d.x: NISAR carries dual radar: NASA supplies the L-band system and ISRO the S-band system.

n165e04b1058.s: Which body oversees genetic manipulation and biosafety in India's biotechnology regulation?
n165e04b1058.x: DBT handles genetic manipulation and biosafety; CDSCO (headed by DCGI) grants clinical-trial and marketing approval.

nf966c3ac10b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2026 criticism of ISRO?
o: ISRO staff unions questioned outsourcing under the 2023 Space Policy
The criticism followed two consecutive PSLV failures
The Department of Space abolished the 2023 Space Policy
About 100 ISRO staff quit the organisation
nf966c3ac10b.x: The 2023 Space Policy was questioned after two PSLV failures in a row, but it was not abolished.

nda35b6e2b65.s: From July 2026, Advanced Therapeutic Products such as gene and CAR-T therapies come under the licensing of:
nda35b6e2b65.x: An amendment to the Drugs Rules, 1945 placed ATPs under the Central Licence Approving Authority; DBT only handles genetic manipulation and biosafety.

ndf8d89c112f.s: The R78C malaria vaccine, which targets blood-stage antigens RIPR and CyPRA, was developed by:
o: Oxford and the Serum Institute of India
Novartis and Medicines for Malaria Venture
ndf8d89c112f.x: R78C is from Oxford and the Serum Institute of India; Novartis and MMV made Coartem Baby, the first malaria drug for newborns.

n37877493de8.s: NIELIT Amaravati, with an outlay of ₹730.70 crore, is an initiative of:
n37877493de8.x: NIELIT Amaravati is a MeitY initiative costing ₹730.70 crore; its classes begin at ANU, Guntur.

na618da3ab54.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Vikram-1 ('Aagaman')?
o: It was built by Skyroot Aerospace, Hyderabad
It made India the third country, after the US and China, with a private orbital rocket
It was built by ISRO's Satish Dhawan Space Centre
na618da3ab54.x: Vikram-1 is Skyroot Aerospace's privately developed orbital rocket, not an ISRO build.

n7d76095eda1.s: The 2-m Himalayan Chandra Telescope at Hanle, Ladakh, is named after:
n7d76095eda1.x: The telescope, dedicated in August 2001 and run remotely from Hosakote by IIA, is named after S. Chandrasekhar.

ca09aa3a8ced1d.s: The UN Ocean Decade covers which period?
ca09aa3a8ced1d.x: The UN Ocean Decade runs from 2021 to 2030.

ca48457205ee8d.s: Didymocarpus nautiyalii, a new plant from Shi-Yomi district of Arunachal Pradesh, honours:
ca48457205ee8d.x: It is named after Prof. Sunil Nautiyal, former Director of the G.B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment.

ca6ef4e69f6105.s: The Desert National Park in the Thar Desert receives an annual rainfall of:
ca6ef4e69f6105.x: The park covers over 3,160 sq km of the Thar and receives under 100 mm of rain.

ca3b3be1de086b.s: Which city won the 10 lakh+ category of Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2026?
ca3b3be1de086b.x: Lucknow won the 10 lakh+ category in 2026 (Indore had won in 2025); Rourkela and Kalinganagar won the smaller categories.

ca261de9c9eb3f.s: The Geographical Indications of Goods Act, 1999 came into force on:
ca261de9c9eb3f.x: The GI Act was enacted in 1999 and came into force on 15 September 2003.

caa6da1edb0ace.s: The UN General Assembly promoted equal-area world maps because the Mercator projection:
caa6da1edb0ace.x: The Mercator projection enlarges high latitudes, which prompted the push for equal-area maps.

ca0c1382523b34.s: Which app provides the Air Quality Index for 292+ Indian cities?
ca0c1382523b34.x: SAMEER gives AQI for 292+ cities; PRANA is the portal that tracks NCAP.

ca643e331ec158.s: The Mercator projection is useful for navigation because:
o: It shows continents at their true area
It shows high latitudes at true size
Constant compass bearings appear as straight lines
It keeps area, shape and distance together
ca643e331ec158.x: On the Mercator projection constant compass bearings are straight lines, which suits navigation.

ca74d012784b43.s: The Pichavaram mangrove study found that most mangrove carbon is stored:
ca74d012784b43.x: The study (302 households in 5 villages) found mangrove carbon mostly stored below ground in sediments.

caf44357f0ac30.s: Under UNCLOS, the Exclusive Economic Zone extends up to:
caf44357f0ac30.x: The EEZ extends up to 200 nautical miles under UNCLOS, not 12.

ca013611606cca.s: The GI tag for Ambaji Mohanthal Prasad was granted on:
ca013611606cca.x: The GI was granted on 8 October 2026; the certificate followed on 11 October, the first day of Sharadiya Navratri.

cab85273956f24.s: After the Nepal rock–ice collapse of August 2026, which barrage did India keep under watch?
cab85273956f24.x: India watched the Valmikinagar Barrage, not Farakka, and alerted Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.

cn6515fe2cd099.s: Mayon Volcano, which erupted on 1 November 2026, is in Albay on which island?
cn6515fe2cd099.x: Mayon is in Albay on Luzon; Mount Kanlaon is on Negros Island.

cn84542236d0a3.s: Tuvalu, formerly known as the Ellice Islands, consists of how many islands?
cn84542236d0a3.x: Tuvalu has nine islands (four reef islands and five atolls); its currency is the Australian Dollar.

cnc62792463727.s: Which country leads the negotiations at COP31, hosted by Turkiye in November 2026?
cnc62792463727.x: Turkiye hosts COP31 (9–20 November 2026), but Australia leads the negotiations.

cn74be5b4e8b65.s: Sauj Jheel, added as a Ramsar site in October 2026, is in:
cn74be5b4e8b65.x: Sauj Jheel is in Uttar Pradesh, not Uttarakhand; Sukhna Wetland (Chandigarh) was added the same day.

cn0ff1857be9b4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Kigali Amendment?
o: India begins its HFC phase-down from 2028
India must achieve an 85% cut by 2047
cn0ff1857be9b4.x: India freezes HFCs by 2028 but begins its phase-down only from 2032.

cn3b0b91a7796f.s: Three new Rhysida centipede species from the Western Ghats were discovered by Malabar Christian College and:
cn3b0b91a7796f.x: The discovery was made by the ZSI with Malabar Christian College, not the Botanical Survey of India.

cn7444ad19c881.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about UNEP's Emissions Gap Report of October 2026?
o: It is the 17th edition of the report
It puts global emissions at 58.4 Gt CO2e in 2025
It says an 18% cut is needed by 2030
It says a 45% cut is needed by 2030
cn7444ad19c881.x: The report needs cuts of 18% by 2030; 45% is the cut needed by 2035.

cne7c00420a02b.s: Protests against the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in October 2026 took place at:
cne7c00420a02b.x: Clashes against the 11,200 MW project took place at Pasighat, not Tezu.

cn29d834502c21.s: IUCN warned in October 2026 that 96% of shallow-water coral reef ecosystems are at risk of collapse by:
cn29d834502c21.x: IUCN's warning is about collapse by 2075, not 2050.

cn1d9ee189047f.s: In October 2026, Maharashtra approved which of the following as wildlife sanctuaries?
cn1d9ee189047f.x: Maharashtra approved Kolamarka and an expanded Tansa among its new wildlife sanctuaries.

cn7dc5051a97b8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the FAO COFO 28 meeting of 2026?
o: It was held in Rome from 28 September to 2 October 2026
India reported its forest and tree cover as 25.17%
The State of the World's Forests 2026 puts degraded land at 1.65 billion ha
It was held along with the 10th World Forest Week
cn7dc5051a97b8.x: The State of the World's Forests 2026 puts degraded land at 1.56 billion ha, not 1.65 billion ha.

cn46d7146e2c42.s: The Mayon eruption of 1 November 2026 was monitored by:
cn46d7146e2c42.x: The Mayon eruption was monitored by PHIVOLCS, not PAGASA.

cnb9724b346017.s: UNEP's 17th Emissions Gap Report (2026) says emissions must be cut by how much by 2040?
cnb9724b346017.x: The report needs cuts of 18% by 2030, 45% by 2035 and 69% by 2040.

cn9996aa197cc9.s: Sukhna Wetland, designated a Ramsar site in October 2026, is located in:
cn9996aa197cc9.x: Sukhna Wetland is in Chandigarh; Sauj Jheel (Uttar Pradesh) was added the same day.

ca72e89e1fee13.s: The Mago Chu Basin, where four of five glacial lakes expanded during 2016–2026, is in which district of Arunachal Pradesh?
ca72e89e1fee13.x: The Mago Chu Basin is in Tawang district, not West Kameng; four of its five lakes expanded.

ca96bdc8c631bd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Van Mahotsav and the India State of Forest Report?
o: The 77th Van Mahotsav was observed from 1 to 7 July 2026
Van Mahotsav was started in 1950 by K. M. Munshi
The ISFR is brought out by the Forest Survey of India
The ISFR is an annual report
ca96bdc8c631bd.x: The ISFR is biennial, not annual; the other statements are correct.

cab138d201e296.s: Which is a hot, long-distance dust wind of North India?
cab138d201e296.x: Loo is a hot long-distance wind; andhi is a short, local dust storm with thunderstorms.

ca309726a630cf.s: Which feedstock was used in the Akola biochar trial on black soil?
ca309726a630cf.x: The Akola trial used maize stalk; coconut leaf stalk was used in Kerala.

ca8cb9971002f4.s: The degraded river Musi flows through which city?
ca8cb9971002f4.x: The Musi flows through Hyderabad; the Cooum is Chennai's, the Sahibi Delhi's and the Mithi Mumbai's.

ca15decfa2723b.s: Bharalu and Bahini are degraded rivers of which city?
ca15decfa2723b.x: Bharalu and Bahini are in Guwahati; Varuna and Assi are in Varanasi, Mula and Mutha in Pune.

ca81dd735d5472.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Western Ghats Eco-Sensitive Area?
o: Hydel projects are completely banned in the proposed ESA
The expert committee constituted in 2022 has been extended up to July 2027
The Gadgil Committee (2011) treated the entire Ghats as sensitive in three zones
The Kasturirangan Committee proposed about 37% of the Ghats as ESA
ca81dd735d5472.x: In the draft ESA, hydel projects are regulated, not banned.

ca54db74039c73.s: The Palghat Gap in the Western Ghats links:
ca54db74039c73.x: The Palghat Gap links Coimbatore and Palakkad; Bhor Ghat links Mumbai–Pune.

ca96988c936b39.s: The South Lhonak Lake outburst of 2023 occurred in which State?
ca96988c936b39.x: South Lhonak Lake is in Sikkim; the 2013 Kedarnath disaster involved Chorabari lake.

caebc0b9b7fdc6.s: The State Disaster Management Authority is headed by the:
caebc0b9b7fdc6.x: The SDMA is headed by the Chief Minister; the District Collector heads the DDMA and the PM chairs the NDMA.

cac9aadff08c8d.s: The Geographical Indications Registry of India, with all-India jurisdiction, is located in:
cac9aadff08c8d.x: The GI Registry is in Chennai and has all-India jurisdiction.

ca84bb2deb43e6.s: The Geographical Indications of Goods Act in India is administered by:
ca84bb2deb43e6.x: The GI Act is administered by DPIIT under the Ministry of Commerce.

ca8d870536b30f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's disaster-management bodies?
o: The NDMA was set up under the Disaster Management Act, 2005
The NDMA is chaired by the Prime Minister
The NDRF functions under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
The DDMA is headed by the District Collector
ca8d870536b30f.x: The NDRF functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs, not MoEFCC.

caa67ac33ea890.s: Kolleru Wildlife Sanctuary in West Godavari and Krishna districts was established in:
caa67ac33ea890.x: The sanctuary was set up in 1999 under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972; Kolleru Lake became a Ramsar site in 2002.

ca419643fdfd58.s: A GI registration in India, valid for 10 years, can be:
ca419643fdfd58.x: GI registration is valid for 10 years and renewable every 10 years.

ca2d4c684567e4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about ZSI's checklist of butterflies and moths?
o: It is India's first comprehensive checklist of Lepidoptera
ca2d4c684567e4.x: The checklist took 12 years and was published in 22 volumes, not 12.

ca765968adba1c.s: In ZSI's Lepidoptera checklist, the superfamily Geometroidea accounts for how many moth species?
ca765968adba1c.x: Geometroidea accounts for 2,205 moth species in the 13,703-species checklist.

ca403633390278.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the five new Impatiens species reported in 2025?
o: They belong to the family Balsaminaceae
They were recorded in Idukki and Ernakulam
They were reported from Kerala's Eastern Ghats
Impatiens xanthopetala is one of them
ca403633390278.x: The species were found in Kerala's Western Ghats, not the Eastern Ghats.

cab3cc956bdddf.s: Hamataliwa papikonda, a new lynx spider, was reported from which State?
cab3cc956bdddf.x: Hamataliwa papikonda was reported from Andhra Pradesh; Simonia lawbah is from Meghalaya.

ca4bcea7edfa5b.s: Which is the largest Critical Tiger Habitat in India?
ca4bcea7edfa5b.x: Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam (Andhra Pradesh and Telangana) is the largest Critical Tiger Habitat.

ca0ba92ad249c5.s: The white-bellied heron was first described in 1878 from which region?
ca0ba92ad249c5.x: It was first described in 1878 from the Teesta region, where it is no longer found.

cab9616da924df.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Sungal Tunnel?
o: It lies on the Jammu–Poonch highway
It passes through the Pir Panjal Range
It cuts travel distance by about 13 km
cab9616da924df.x: The 2.79 km Sungal Tunnel passes through the Kalidhar Range, not the Pir Panjal.

ca2c8fb6ea5806.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Indira Point and Ana Sagar Lake?
o: Indira Point was formerly called Pygmalion Point
Ana Sagar Lake was built by Arnoraja Chauhan
Ana Sagar Lake was built by damming the Chambal River
ca2c8fb6ea5806.x: Ana Sagar was built (1135–1150 AD) by damming the Luni River, not the Chambal.

ca48f6ae4e043b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Great Nicobar Project?
o: The National Green Tribunal cancelled its environmental clearance
The Shompen are classified as a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group
The Giant Leatherback Turtle nests at Galathea Bay
Its transshipment terminal is planned at Galathea Bay
ca48f6ae4e043b.x: The NGT refused to interfere with the clearance and demanded strict compliance; it did not cancel it.

cae33628cee685.s: The Kishau Multipurpose Dam is being built on which river?
cae33628cee685.x: The dam is on the Tons, the largest tributary of the Yamuna, under an MoU of six States.

ca7ad00374badf.s: The Border Roads Organisation, established in 1960, functions under the:
o: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
ca7ad00374badf.x: The BRO functions under the Ministry of Defence and is headquartered in New Delhi.

new.s: The ABO blood groups were discovered by:
new.x: Karl Landsteiner discovered the ABO blood groups (published 1901).

new.s: Which blood group is the universal donor of red cells?
new.x: O negative has no A, B or Rh antigen, so it is the universal red-cell donor; AB positive is the universal recipient.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about blood groups:
1. Antigens sit on red blood cells, while antibodies are in the plasma.
2. AB positive is the universal recipient.
3. For plasma, the universal donor is group O.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; for plasma the universal donor is AB, not O.

new.s: A person whose red blood cells carry the Rh factor is classified as:
new.x: Rh factor present means Rh positive; absent means Rh negative.

new.s: The 108th session of the Indian Science Congress, the last one held, took place at:
new.x: The 108th session was held at Nagpur in January 2023; the 109th at LPU was put on hold.

new.s: The Indian Science Congress Association was founded in:
new.x: The ISCA was founded in 1914 and holds the annual Science Congress session.

new.s: The Indian Biological Data Centre of DBT is located at:
new.x: The Indian Biological Data Centre is at RCB, Faridabad; LIGO-India is at Hingoli.

new.s: Digiboxx, which offers 20 GB of free cloud storage, was launched by:
new.x: Digiboxx is a NITI Aayog initiative; Sangam Digital Twin is of the Department of Telecommunications.

new.s: The VEGA series of RISC-V processors was developed by:
new.x: VEGA is C-DAC's RISC-V series; SHAKTI is from IIT Madras.

new.s: Coartem Baby, WHO-prequalified in May 2026, is the first:
new.x: Coartem Baby, by Novartis and Medicines for Malaria Venture, is the first malaria drug for newborns.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: IndOss (CSIR-NCL) is a bone substitute; Nafithromycin is an antibiotic, Qdenga a dengue vaccine and Covishield a COVID-19 vaccine.

new.s: The Andes strain of Hantavirus, linked to cruise-ship deaths in May 2026, is:
new.x: Hantavirus is rodent-borne, not mosquito-borne.

new.s: NASA's OSIRIS-REx returned samples in 2023 from which asteroid?
new.x: OSIRIS-REx returned Bennu samples in 2023; renamed OSIRIS-APEX, it now heads for Apophis.

new.s: BlueBird Block-2, the heaviest payload launched from Indian soil (6,100 kg), was carried by:
new.x: LVM3-M6 launched the 6,100 kg BlueBird Block-2 of AST SpaceMobile on 24 December 2025.

new.s: RudraM-II, developed by DRDO's RCI Hyderabad with the IAF, is a(n):
new.x: RudraM-II is an anti-radiation missile; Khagantak-243 is a glide bomb and LRLACM a land-attack cruise missile.

new.s: DBT's GenomeIndia project has sequenced 10,000 genomes from how many population groups?
new.x: GenomeIndia covers 10,000 genomes from 83 population groups, with a plan to grow to 1 lakh.

new.s: Majorana 2 (2026) holds qubit coherence for about how long on average?
new.x: Majorana 2 holds coherence for about 20 s on average, up to 1 minute.

new.s: The secretariat of the UNFCCC is located at:
new.x: The UNFCCC secretariat is in Bonn; the CBD's is in Montreal and UNEP is headquartered in Nairobi.

new.s: The Paris Agreement, adopted at COP21 in 2015, entered into force on:
new.x: The Paris Agreement entered into force on 4 November 2016.

new.s: According to UNEP's 2026 Emissions Gap Report, the new NDCs cut emissions by only about how much by 2030?
new.x: New NDCs cut emissions only 5–8% by 2030 and 11–15% by 2035, far short of the 18% needed by 2030.

new.s: Tuvalu, threatened by sea-level rise, is the world's:
new.x: Tuvalu, about 26 sq km, is the world's fourth-smallest country.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Short-Lived Climate Pollutants:
1. Black carbon is a greenhouse gas.
2. Tropospheric ozone is not directly emitted.
3. Sulphate aerosols have a cooling effect.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct; black carbon is a particle that absorbs radiation, not a greenhouse gas.

new.s: Over 20 years, methane warms the planet about how many times more than CO2?
new.x: Methane has about 80 times the warming effect of CO2 over 20 years.

new.s: The HFCs controlled under the Kigali Amendment are regulated because they:
new.x: HFCs do not deplete ozone; the Kigali Amendment phases them down for their warming effect.

new.s: The State Energy Efficiency Index 2024 was released by:
new.x: The 6th State Energy Efficiency Index (2024) is by BEE.

new.s: Which State topped the State Energy Efficiency Index 2024?
new.x: Maharashtra topped; Andhra Pradesh, Assam and Tripura led their groups.

new.s: Mawmluh Cave, among the first 100 IUGS geological heritage sites, is in:
new.x: Mawmluh Cave is in the East Khasi Hills of Meghalaya.

new.s: Mawmluh Cave has been recognised as a geological heritage site by:
new.x: Mawmluh Cave is among the first 100 geological heritage sites of the IUGS.

new.s: The UNGA resolution promoting equal-area world maps ('Correct the Map') was moved by:
new.x: Togo moved the resolution; 164 of 193 voted in favour, including India, while the USA voted against.

new.s: A cyclone in the North Indian Ocean is given a name when its wind speed reaches:
new.x: A name is assigned at 34 knots (about 63 km/h), sequentially, not by the landfall country.

new.s: MISHTI, the mangrove initiative launched in 2023, has an outlay of:
new.x: MISHTI (2023) has ₹100 crore; ₹767 crore is National Coastal Mission 2.0.

new.s: COP18 of the Convention on Biological Diversity will be held in 2028 at:
new.x: COP17 was at Yerevan in 2026; COP18 is set for Quito, Ecuador in 2028.

new.s: Which of the following has its secretariat in Montreal?
new.x: The CBD secretariat is in Montreal; IUCN, WWF and the Ramsar secretariat are at Gland.

new.s: The Botanical Survey of India was established in:
new.x: BSI dates from 1890 and ZSI from 1916; both are headquartered in Kolkata.

new.s: Ophiorrhiza shidiensis and Ophiorrhiza pemae, found in Arunachal Pradesh, belong to which family?
new.x: Ophiorrhiza is in Rubiaceae (coffee family); Osbeckia is Melastomataceae and Didymocarpus Gesneriaceae.

new.s: How many tiger reserves in India are now CA|TS-accredited?
new.x: India now has 24 CA|TS-accredited tiger reserves, not 15; Assam has 4.

new.s: The CA|TS framework, launched in 2013, has:
new.x: CA|TS has 7 pillars and 17 elements: the first 5 pillars are CA and the last 2 TS.

new.s: What is the IUCN status of the snow leopard?
new.x: The snow leopard is IUCN Vulnerable; the Great Indian Bustard is Critically Endangered.

new.s: According to SPAI 2024, India has about how many snow leopards?
new.x: SPAI 2024 counted 718 snow leopards in India, with Ladakh highest at 477.

new.s: The UNFCCC's SB64 mid-year climate talks in June 2026 were held at:
new.x: SB64 took place at Bonn from 8 to 18 June 2026.

new.s: At the first UNFCCC Dialogue on Trade and Climate (June 2026), developing countries objected to:
new.x: Developing countries objected to climate-linked trade measures, and India pushed back on new obligations.

new.s: What was India's rank in the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2026?
new.x: India fell 13 places from 10th to 23rd, becoming a medium performer.

new.s: The Climate Change Performance Index is published by:
new.x: The CCPI is by Germanwatch, NewClimate Institute and Climate Action Network.

new.s: Kīlauea in Hawaii is a:
new.x: Kīlauea is a shield volcano of the Hawaiian hotspot; Mount Merapi is a stratovolcano.

new.s: Bhagaiya Silk, which received a GI tag in 2026, belongs to which State?
new.x: Bhagaiya Silk is from Jharkhand, not Assam.

new.s: As per Plant Discoveries 2025, which State recorded the most new plant taxa?
new.x: Arunachal led plant finds (49); Kerala led new animals (98).

new.s: The Zojila Tunnel, the world's highest road tunnel under construction, is about how long?
new.x: Zojila Tunnel is 13.153 km; Sungal Tunnel is 2.79 km.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the International Big Cat Alliance:
1. It covers seven big cats, including the jaguar and puma.
2. Bangladesh became its 27th member.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: IBCA covers seven big cats and Bangladesh became its 27th member.

new.s: The India State of Forest Report is brought out every two years by the:
new.x: The ISFR is a biennial report of the Forest Survey of India (Dehradun, 1981).
